name: Dub's Dread Golf Club
reasons: holes not all mapped in OSM (hole method: structure)
foot: Automatic page (not hand checked): course from OpenStreetMap, card from no card, trees / long grass / water from the vision layer on USDA NAIP + USGS 3DEP lidar, OB inferred from the course outline and buildings. Solved tee sets: osm_back. See qa_report.md for the hole-by-hole checks.

review.why: holes 3, 4, 6, 7, 12, 13: wrong par or yardage; 2 more with a wrong tee or pick

3: Card 446, page 434 (-12) from the back OSM box; tee probably 10-12 yds further back (unmapped). Par 4 = card.
4: Page hole 4 is a copy of hole 13 (same tee and green; structure inference). The real hole 4 is a par 3, card 216: OSM has it as way 1029130675 with no ref.
5: Card 382, page 352 from a forward box; the OSM hole way starts ~25 yds further back (way length 378). Tee moved to the hole-way start (supplement adds a tee box there).
6: Card 467; page shows 488 (measured along the bent hole line; straight 441). Tee on the back OSM box is right; only the shown yardage is off.
7: Card 550; page shows 570 (hole-line path; straight 554). Tee OK.
9: Card 418, page 367 from a forward box; the OSM hole way starts ~29 yds back (way 399 yds). Moved to the hole-way start (~390-399 yds); the last ~20 yds are still unexplained (tips may share the 18th tee area). Uncertain.
12: Par 5 on the card (547), page plays it as a par 4 (OSM tag par=4) at 555. Wrong par changes the strategy (driver vs layup to a par-5 second).
13: Card 420, page 407 (-13). Tee on the back OSM box; probably a small unmapped walk-back. Hole 13 itself is right (page hole 4 duplicated it).
